prompt:
Read the logical world and question. First formalize the complete world and question as labelled finite-FOL Prolog terms for later inspection. Then answer the English question yourself; do not execute Prolog or any tool.

Use domain(person,[...]), axiom(s1,...), explicit not(...), and(...), or(...), xor(...), implies(...), forall(...), and exists(...) where appropriate. Preserve every source sentence exactly once, with its English as a preceding comment. The query must be labelled_explanation(Goal, Status, Package), with no ?- and no trailing period.

Return JSON only: {"program":"...","query":"...","answer":"A"|"B"|"C"}.

World:
Dash does not develop spikes. If Dash grows in size, then he either strengthens his body or develops horns (or both). Dash grows in size. Dash did not strengthen his body. If Dash's body parts ossify, then he either gains protection or loses agility, but not both. If Dash matures, then he will grow sharp claws. If Dash either raises his scales or bares his teeth (but not both), then he will become defensive. Dash's body parts ossify. If Dash is defensive, then he lives in groups and relies on his intelligence. Dash does not become formidable. If Dash develops horns, then he will either grow sharp claws or thicken his scales, but not both. If Dash either develops spikes or grows sharp claws (but not both), then he will become defensive. Every dinosaur that either thickens its scales or gains protection will become formidable. Dash does not rely on his intelligence. Dash lives in groups.

Question:
Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? Dash loses agility.

output.program:
domain(person,[dash])

% Dash does not develop spikes.
axiom(s1,not(develops_spikes(dash)))

% If Dash grows in size, then he either strengthens his body or develops horns (or both).
axiom(s2,implies(grows_in_size(dash),or(strengthens_body(dash),develops_horns(dash))))

% Dash grows in size.
axiom(s3,grows_in_size(dash))

% Dash did not strengthen his body.
axiom(s4,not(strengthens_body(dash)))

% If Dash's body parts ossify, then he either gains protection or loses agility, but not both.
axiom(s5,implies(body_parts_ossify(dash),xor(gains_protection(dash),loses_agility(dash))))

% If Dash matures, then he will grow sharp claws.
axiom(s6,implies(matures(dash),grows_sharp_claws(dash)))

% If Dash either raises his scales or bares his teeth (but not both), then he will become defensive.
axiom(s7,implies(xor(raises_scales(dash),bares_teeth(dash)),becomes_defensive(dash)))

% Dash's body parts ossify.
axiom(s8,body_parts_ossify(dash))

% If Dash is defensive, then he lives in groups and relies on his intelligence.
axiom(s9,implies(defensive(dash),and(lives_in_groups(dash),relies_on_intelligence(dash))))

% Dash does not become formidable.
axiom(s10,not(becomes_formidable(dash)))

% If Dash develops horns, then he will either grow sharp claws or thicken his scales, but not both.
axiom(s11,implies(develops_horns(dash),xor(grows_sharp_claws(dash),thickens_scales(dash))))

% If Dash either develops spikes or grows sharp claws (but not both), then he will become defensive.
axiom(s12,implies(xor(develops_spikes(dash),grows_sharp_claws(dash)),becomes_defensive(dash)))

% Every dinosaur that either thickens its scales or gains protection will become formidable.
axiom(s13,forall(X,implies(or(thickens_scales(X),gains_protection(X)),becomes_formidable(X))))

% Dash does not rely on his intelligence.
axiom(s14,not(relies_on_intelligence(dash)))

% Dash lives in groups.
axiom(s15,lives_in_groups(dash))
